sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_user_profile" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "remote_user_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "encrypted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("encrypted" IN (0, 1)), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "app_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "system_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "persons" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_paise" > 0), "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "txn_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "money_ledger" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "principal_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("principal_paise" > 0), "entry_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "money_settlements" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ledger_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES money_ledger (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_paise" > 0), "settled_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "groups_cache" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "group_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "is_shared" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_shared" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_members_cache" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES groups_cache (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "is_self" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_self" IN (0, 1)), "joined_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_expenses_cache" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES groups_cache (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_paise" > 0), "paid_by_member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES group_members_cache (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "expense_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "split_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_expense_splits_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expense_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES group_expenses_cache (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES group_members_cache (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "share_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("share_paise" >= 0), "input_value" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("expense_id", "member_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_settlements_cache" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES groups_cache (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "from_member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES group_members_cache (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "to_member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES group_members_cache (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_paise" > 0), "settled_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (from_member_id <> to_member_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ledger_entry_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES money_ledger (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "group_expense_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES group_expenses_cache (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "stored_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_path" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((transaction_id IS NOT NULL) + (ledger_entry_id IS NOT NULL) + (group_expense_id IS NOT NULL) = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repeat" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "ledger_entry_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES money_ledger (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "group_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES groups_cache (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("op_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("op_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_inbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "applied_at" INTEGER NULL, "error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op_id" TEXT NULL, "local_payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_payload" TEXT NULL, "remote_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "detected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER NULL, "resolution" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_backup_history_created ON backup_history (created_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_categories_type ON categories (type, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_persons_name ON persons (name)
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_date ON transactions (txn_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_category ON transactions (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_person ON transactions (person_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_ledger_person ON money_ledger (person_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_ledger_due ON money_ledger (due_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_settlements_ledger ON money_settlements (ledger_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_members_group ON group_members_cache (group_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_gexp_group_date ON group_expenses_cache (group_id, expense_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_gsplit_expense ON group_expense_splits_cache (expense_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_gsettle_group ON group_settlements_cache (group_id, settled_on)
CREATE INDEX idx_att_txn ON attachments (transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_att_ledger ON attachments (ledger_entry_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_att_gexp ON attachments (group_expense_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_reminders_due ON reminders (status, due_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_status ON sync_outbox (status, created_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_conflicts_open ON sync_conflicts (resolved_at)
